description.value:
To compete with top competitors Arasaka and Kang Tao, you need a cutting-edge product. This is why Tsunami has poured tremendous resources into the AI-powered processors they use in their Kappa handgun. Tsunami's latest software update has brought Kappa to the forefront of the smartgun debate. Add to that their strong reputation for quality craftsmanship, and you get a weapon that has raised eyebrows throughout the market.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When making an Autofire (Machine Pistol 4) Attack with this weapon, the user may opt to instead make an Autofire (Machine Pistol 3) Attack to attempt firing at an additional target that is within 8m/yds of the first target without expending any additional ammunition or requiring another Action. Each Autofire Check is rolled individually, but the user suffers a -2 penalty on both Checks.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
